# The file writes TestForestWrittenOnlyByTheKernel (forestwriter_class_test.go) still
# permits in a package that reads work sets, one `file:function # what it writes` per
# line. The forest -- every file under docs/roadmaps/ -- was written only by the nova-work
# kernel (#3340), through deprecated/cmd/nova-work/forestwrite.go writeWorkSet, which is
# parked under deprecated/ (2026-09-27); no living code writes the forest. None of the writes below is a work set, and
# the ones whose target is a flag are refused on a forest path by their verb. The list
# only shrinks: an entry whose write has left is a red run, as is a write not listed.
internal/tokens/dayfile.go:DayFile.Save # the token usage day file
internal/tokens/foldpool.go:WritePoolLedger # the token pool ledger TSV
internal/tokens/lock.go:TakeFoldLock # the fold output directory's lock file
internal/tokens/lock_other.go:tryLockFile # the fold lock's sentinel on platforms without flock
internal/tokens/opencode.go:copyFile # the opencode usage database copy the fold reads
internal/tokens/package.go:AtomicNoReplaceRename # the token package marker, linked no-replace
internal/tokens/package.go:StageMarker # the token package marker's staged temp file
internal/worklang/expand.go:ExpandDirWithSink # plan expand's cards under --out, job storage; a forest --out is refused by the verb
